title: HC Hong Lu & Heathcliff, achievements, and some other updates

texts: Added 3F Public Address room Hong Lu and King of Needleworks data to identities and Clash Arena.
Updated the Achievements Tracker. Achievement progress should automatically reset.
Changed the SP min and max limits in Clash Arena to -50 and 50 respectively for anyone who wants to play with guaranteed coin flips.
Fixed an issue in the Extraction Simulator where old event reward identities weren't included in sinner target banners.
Fixed an issue where using encounter tokens could sometimes crash the page under certain circumstances.
